title: Walking out on Getz and Mose Allison's arrival
summary: Cobb confronts Getz, who cries, and sends for Mose Allison, who then stands up to him on stage.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: And so--OK so now, that was the attitude. So me and Jimmy Cobb said 'well, look, man. He might as well pay us off because if he go, then we go.' Cause at first we hadn't been, you know, we're listening at this dude. We had got tired of his mouth, hearing his mouth anyway.
And you know how Jimmy Cobb is, man. He start working his nose and stuff, you know, he ready to punch him in the mouth.

So Jimmy said, 'look. Let me tell you something, little boy.' Say, 'what is all this--you going around firing, firing, firing, firing somebody because of applause.' Now, we come to find out, that's when we find out that this guy Stan Getz wasn't nothing but a little faggot. And he started crying just like a little boy, man. 'Ya'll going
to leave me out here. You going to leave me out of the band," and all this kind of stuff. And the piano player he sent for You never could imagine--Mose Allison.

Yeah. Mose Allison. Mose Allison met us in the next town. And we went on and he oh, man, he would walk all over. And Mose Allison step all on his chest, you know, just talk about him loud on the stage and stuff, man. But he never would do that with me and Jimmy Cobb, you know.

We--we'll look at him and told him, "man, if you ever say something like that to me," say "if I was him, I would--I should tell him on the band," say "man if I was Mose, I would get up and knock your butt off the stage," you know. But he would never say nothing to me and Jimmy.
